$comment: The machines that work on T3.CodeShip share this configuration (~/.agents/rules/machines.md). Check a machine with: node ~/.agents/tools/machine-config.mjs check <checkout>. Only 'machines' differs per machine. 'automations' says where each task runs and 'scheduled_tasks' its prompt file, schedule and model; the check compares each machine's CodeShip tasks with them. 'toolchain.node' makes the check compare the machine's Node with package.json engines.node, the version check:changed requires.
$automation_order: "one" runs each occurrence on the first machine that is up, in this order. Each task's settings exclude Zoro-PC. The job machine gets no copy: it is not linked to these machines, and CodeShip accepts no exclusion for a machine no copy reaches.
$scheduled_tasks: The weekly sync runs on Opus at xhigh effort with automatic account choice, so each machine picks a signed-in Claude account; translations follow the machine's default scheduled-task model.
